positions.thesis: Duration-long / receive MX CRAH27 (paper alias CORRA_2027-03, family locked to CORRA/CRA). Long in this book is long duration with P&L inverted in implied-rate space: profits if Mar-27 implied CORRA falls from 3.13 toward the still-alive near-term path (1m Dec-2026 2.58, 3m Dec-2026 CRAZ26 2.775), not if Canada catches up to SOFR. The 2027 contract is where the unwarranted hiking cycle is concentrated; do not migrate onto SOFR, AONIA, CA-US 2Y, or USDCAD.

pms.thesis: Keep the concentrated receive in March 2027 CORRA. Cash at 2.29 still leaves about 83 basis points of hikes inside 3.12, so the book is paid to sit in a Canadian path that does not fully deliver that tightening. The contract has cheapened to 3.12, one basis point through the 3.13 entry, which confirms the thesis rather than completing it. Oil near 99 is the live threat to a Canadian reprice, but it does not justify cutting a working concentrated receive or opening a second ticket because paper P&L lags a leader.

The line is already working by a basis point, shocked risk is small, and with a unanimous hold handoff there is no cleaner markable complement in Canada, Australia, Europe, or Japan.

pms.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
pms.thesis: The book stays flat. The accepted fourteen-trader handoff is a unanimous hold, with no expanding tickets that would create new risk, so there is no independent markable opportunity against which official SOFR can be charged on shocked-risk capital. Sitting out is the correct action when other desks are not offering new Canada, Australia, Europe or Japan risk.
